headline: EQUINOX GOLD + ORLA MINING CLOSE JULY 31 — Canada's #2 Gold Producer Born With 1.1M oz/yr and $18.5B Enterprise Value (TSX/NYSE: EQX/ORLA)
snippet: Following a 99.9% shareholder vote approval and a final court order from the Supreme Court of British Columbia on July 28, Equinox Gold and Orla Mining are set to complete their business combination on July 31, 2026. The combined company will hold six producing gold operations across the Americas with annual production guidance exceeding 1.1 million ounces and a combined enterprise value of approximately US$18.5 billion — creating Canada's second-largest gold producer behind Agnico Eagle. Orla shareholders received 1 Equinox share plus USD $0.0001 per share, and the G3 Goldfields exploration spinout has already begun trading separately. This closes the most significant gold sector M&A event of 2026 and sets the template for mid-tier consolidation in a $4,000 gold environment.

headline: ALAMOS GOLD Q2: RECORD ISLAND GOLD OUTPUT, $270M NET EARNINGS — 130,600 oz Produced (Up 5% QoQ); Adj. EPS $0.59; Conference Call July 30 (TSX/NYSE: AGI)
snippet: Alamos Gold reported Q2 2026 production of 130,600 ounces — up 5% from Q1 and meeting revised quarterly guidance — as the Island Gold District delivered record underground mining rates, milling rates, and production for the quarter. Net earnings reached $270.4 million ($0.64 per share), with adjusted net earnings of $247.6 million ($0.59 per share). Strong Island Gold performance partially offset weaker results at Mulatos and Young-Davidson. Management hosted a conference call on July 30 to discuss the results and full-year outlook. When a mid-tier producer of Alamos' quality hits record operational milestones at $4,000+ gold, it validates the leverage argument for well-run junior explorers building toward production in the same bull market.

headline: ENDEAVOUR SILVER Q2: REVENUE SURGES 149% TO $212M — Net Earnings $66.5M vs. $20.5M Loss in 2025; Silver Realized at $70.16/oz (TSX/NYSE: EDR/EXK)
snippet: Endeavour Silver Corp. announced Q2 2026 financial results on July 30, reporting revenue of $212.1 million — up 149% year-over-year — driven by record sales of 2,054,108 oz silver and 10,823 oz gold at realized prices of $70.16/oz silver and $4,305/oz gold. Net earnings swung to $66.5 million from a $20.5 million loss in Q2 2025, with EBITDA of $110.9 million. The transformation reflects Terronera LNG plant commissioning and the Kolpa expansion to 2,500 tonnes per day, which drove the 31% YoY production increase. AISC rose 47% to $36.89/oz silver — elevated, but still generating strong margins at current prices. The company held $236.6 million cash at quarter-end, with $214.4 million in working capital.

headline: SILVER DROPS 1.4% ON PCE DAY, GOLD-SILVER RATIO HITS 70:1 — June PCE In-Line; $4,066 Gold Holds While Silver Tests $57 Support Again
snippet: Silver dropped 1.4% on July 30 following the release of June PCE data — the Fed's preferred inflation gauge — bringing the gold-silver ratio back to approximately 70:1 as gold held near $4,066 while silver retreated toward its $57 near-term support. The divergence is analytically useful: gold is pricing in rate stability and central bank demand while silver's industrial component makes it sensitive to growth expectations. At a 70:1 ratio, silver is historically inexpensive relative to gold — but compressing the ratio requires macro conditions to cooperate. The six-consecutive-year structural supply deficit (46.3 million ounces projected for 2026) provides the fundamental floor, but June PCE data was not the soft print silver needed to break out.

headline: ALLIED GOLD Q2: 97,429 oz AT AISC BELOW $2,200 — Kurmuk Mine Starting in H2; Production Up 7% YoY as Bonikro Leads (NYSE/TSX: AAUC)
snippet: Allied Gold Corporation released preliminary Q2 2026 operating results on July 29, reporting production of 97,429 gold ounces — up 7% from Q2 2025 — with first-half 2026 total production of 193,445 ounces. All-in Sustaining Costs for Q2 are expected to be below $2,200 per ounce. Bonikro delivered the strongest quarterly contribution, Sadiola improved through the quarter, and Agbaou continued its planned transition to fresh ore. H2 2026 production visibility is supported by the Kurmuk Mine in Ethiopia beginning to contribute output. The Q2 results were released one day after Zijin Gold's full acquisition attempt was terminated and restructured as a US$295 million minority investment — Allied Gold's African operations are now generating cash with a strategic Chinese anchor shareholder on the register.

headline: DRYDEN GOLD DISCOVERS TWO NEW STRUCTURES AT GOLD ROCK — Elora 2 at 250-500m Depth and Paymaster Both Hit in First Tests; Ontario District Scale Keeps Expanding (TSXV: DRY)
snippet: Dryden Gold Corp. (TSXV: DRY) announced July 29 the discovery of two new gold-bearing structures at its Gold Rock flagship project in Ontario's Wabigoon Greenstone Belt. Hole DRG-062 intersected the Elora 2 structure — a new brecciated quartz vein zone comparable to the high-grade Big Master system — at 250–500 metres true depth with no surface expression, confirming the system extends well below current modelled depths. The first test of the Paymaster target in hole DRG-064 returned 7.0 metres at 0.36 g/t gold at 120 metres true depth in what appears to be a wide shear structure. Gold Rock now has gold-bearing structures confirmed along several kilometres of strike, open in all directions, in one of Ontario's most historically productive greenstone belts.

headline: NEWCORE GOLD DRILLS 3.67 g/t AU OVER 25.3m AT NYAM — Highest Grade-Thickness at Enchi Ghana; Converting Inferred to Indicated in 80,000m Program (TSXV: NCAU)
snippet: Newcore Gold Ltd. (TSXV: NCAU, OTCQX: NCAUF) released July 29 results from its 80,000-metre drill program at the Enchi Gold Project in Ghana, with hole NBDD088 returning 3.67 g/t Au over 25.3 metres from 307.7 metres depth at the Nyam deposit — the highest grade-thickness result at Nyam to date. The hole targets high-grade fresh rock mineralization to convert Inferred ounces to Indicated ahead of a prefeasibility study. Enchi hosts a Probable Reserve of 1,055,000 ounces at 0.64 g/t and an Indicated Resource of 1,502,000 ounces at 0.56 g/t. High-grade infill drilling at depth is the pre-PFS technical work that turns a permitted development-stage project into a bankable one — particularly with a gold price backdrop that makes the economics work.

headline: WHITE GOLD CORP YUKON: 56m @ 3.23 g/t AND 50.2m @ 6.89 g/t AT GOLDEN SADDLE — PEA in Final Stages; Three Rigs Turning on Canada's Highest-Grade Open-Pit Candidate (TSXV: WGO)
source_name: Investing News Network / White Gold Corp.
snippet: White Gold Corp. (TSXV: WGO) provided a July 29 update on its fully funded 2026 exploration program in Yukon's White Gold District, reporting highlight intercepts of 56.10 metres at 3.23 g/t gold and 50.2 metres at 6.89 g/t gold from the Golden Saddle deposit — part of the company's largest-ever drill program with three rigs and 7,000 metres completed to date across Golden Saddle, Arc, Ryan's Surprise, and VG deposits. Two new discovery targets — Golden Saddle 2.0 and VG East — are showing early anomalous results. A Preliminary Economic Assessment for the White Gold Project is in its final stages. White Gold's open-pittable, high-grade deposit in a stable Yukon jurisdiction is one of Canada's most compelling advanced explorer stories at current gold prices.

headline: FOMC VOTE WAS SPLIT: TWO HAWKS VOTED FOR A HIKE — Why Gold Couldn't Rally and Silver Sold Off Despite the 'Hold' Headline; September Risk Stays Alive
snippet: GoldSilver.com's July 29 post-FOMC analysis argues that gold and silver's muted reaction to the Federal Reserve's rate hold was driven by the vote tally, not the headline outcome: two voting members dissented in favour of a 25-basis-point hike, signalling the committee consensus is more fragile than the hold suggests. The piece contends that gold's refusal to rally beyond $4,020 and silver's subsequent sell-off on PCE day both reflect the market correctly pricing a non-trivial probability of a September hike if inflation data stays warm. The split vote is the mechanism that kept the gold-silver ratio elevated and explains why junior miners failed to break out of their recent trading range despite a nominally dovish meeting result. The September FOMC decision is now the next binary catalyst.
